relationships.subject: Bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: Bradykinin stimulates ANO1 via IP3-mediated Ca<sup>2+</sup> release from intracellular stores

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: whereas TRPV1 stimulates ANO1 via a combination of Ca<sup>2+</sup> influx and release

relationships.subject: nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Nerve injury causes upregulation of ANO1 expression in DRG neurons, which is blocked by ANO1 antagonists.

key_findings: Review: ANO1 is a Ca2+-activated Cl- channel in nociceptors linked to bradykinin receptor and TRPV1 signalling.
Conditional Ano1 ablation in DRG neurons reduces acute thermal pain and inflammatory/neuropathic allodynia.
